fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects code execution via Pester.bat (Pester - Powershell Modulte for testing)
fields.name: Execute Code with Pester.bat as Parent
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((src.process.image.path contains "\\powershell.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\pwsh.exe") and src.process.cmdline contains "\\WindowsPowerShell\\Modules\\Pester\\") and (src.process.cmdline contains "{ Invoke-Pester -EnableExit ;" or src.process.cmdline contains "{ Get-Help \"")))
